proof_mode: Ordinary mathematical proofs with finite exact regression checks and separate floating-point diagnostics
novelty_scope: Research contribution relative to the targeted repository material inspected; not an exhaustive historical-priority or incoming-archive audit

claims.label: thm:single
claims.scope: r>=2, Re(s)>1, Re(a)>0 for the ordinary ordered sum; meromorphic continuation to all s
claims.proof: Polynomial finite-difference annihilation, finite endpoint moment formula, normal convergence, and Cauchy--Binet

claims.label: thm:polarized
claims.scope: Symmetrized ordered partition with independent Re(s_j)>1, Re(a_j)>0; averaged by 1/r!
claims.conclusion: Finite coefficients plus a linear combination of single Hurwitz zeta functions; no zeta products
claims.exclusion: No reduction of each unsymmetrized assignment is asserted

claims.label: thm:gamma
claims.scope: Every integer order m>=2 for the convergent partition, with a Bell-polynomial weight identity also at m=1
claims.conclusion: All-particle Gamma-weighted local harmonic Bell sums reduce to U_r(m,a)+V_r(m,a)*zeta(m,a)

claims.label: thm:subtraction
claims.scope: Ordinary locally normally convergent bracketed series for Re(s)>0 and Re(a)>0
claims.exclusion: This is not the general higher-resonance Gauss deformation

claims.label: thm:jets
claims.scope: Every fixed derivative order k>=0, Re(a)>0
claims.conclusion: Ordinary convergent determinant-block series with explicit triangular Stieltjes coefficient formulas and nonzero first coefficient

claims.label: cor:cutoff
claims.conclusion: Spectral Laurent constant minus hard-cutoff constant equals partial_s A_r(1,a)

claims.label: thm:classification
claims.source_target: Determinantal Harmonic Resonance further-research question on rank-one harmonic matrix pencils with repeated poles
claims.scope: Proper rational weights on finitely many distinct translated integer lattices with Re(a_nu)>0
claims.conclusion: All coefficient matrices share either one geometric Hankel direction v(tau)v(tau)^T or the final-coordinate corner direction; explicit necessary and sufficient residue equations

claims.label: thm:critical
claims.scope: R(x)=kappa*x^(-(2r-1))+O(x^(-2r)), kappa nonzero, in the specified rational-weight model
claims.conclusion: Rank-one harmonic pencil iff R=Delta^(2r-2)F/(2r-2)! for a unique proper rational seed F
claims.exclusion: The nonzero leading coefficient cannot be replaced by mere O(x^(-(2r-1))) decay

claims.label: thm:depth
claims.scope: Rational pole shifts; generating functions in |z|<1 and normalized positive Euler primitives
claims.conclusion: Generic harmonic rank rho gives a constructive cyclotomic polylog representation of depth at most rho+1
exclusions: No minimal arithmetic-depth or period-independence claim
No general noninteger-order classical-polylog cutoff closure

claims.label: thm:explicitGF
claims.conclusion: Exact expression in Li_(2,2)(z,1), Li_1(z), Li_2(z), Li_4(z), and rational functions

not_claimed: Proof of Gaussian S6 or revised S8
Resolution of general higher Gauss resonances
Exhaustive audit of all six incoming archives
Direct pointwise-sum interpretation of all continued nonpositive spectral values
